cards.name: Éomer, King of Rohan
cards.oracleText:
Double strike
Éomer enters with a +1/+1 counter on it for each other Human you control.
When Éomer enters, target player becomes the monarch. Éomer deals damage equal to its power to any target.

cards.name: Éomer, Marshal of Rohan
cards.oracleText:
Haste
Whenever one or more other attacking legendary creatures you control die, untap all creatures you control. After this phase, there is an additional combat phase. This ability triggers only once each turn.

cards.name: Éomer of the Riddermark
cards.oracleText:
Haste
Whenever Éomer attacks, if you control a creature with the greatest power among creatures on the battlefield, create a 1/1 white Human Soldier creature token.

cards.name: Éomer of the Riddermark // Éomer of the Riddermark
Eon Frolicker
cards.oracleText:
Flying
When this creature enters, if you cast it, target opponent takes an extra turn after this one. Until your next turn, you and planeswalkers you control gain protection from that player. (You and planeswalkers you control can't be targeted, dealt damage, or enchanted by anything controlled by that player.)

cards.name: Éowyn, Fearless Knight
cards.oracleText:
Haste
When Éowyn enters, exile target creature an opponent controls with greater power. Legendary creatures you control gain protection from each of that creature's colors until end of turn.

cards.name: Éowyn, Fearless Knight // Éowyn, Fearless Knight
Éowyn, Shieldmaiden
cards.oracleText:
First strike
At the beginning of combat on your turn, if another Human entered the battlefield under your control this turn, create two 2/2 red Human Knight creature tokens with trample and haste. Then if you control six or more Humans, draw a card.

cards.name: Éowyn, Lady of Rohan
cards.oracleText:
At the beginning of combat on your turn, target creature gains your choice of first strike or vigilance until end of turn. If that creature is equipped, it gains first strike and vigilance until end of turn instead.
